title: Self-development test standard
summary: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing Pancreator self-development tests MUST apply the testing handbook this policy references for contract value, proof cost, fixtures, and lane placement.
instructions: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing tests in self-development MUST read the complete testing guidance this policy references, and MUST apply it before completion.
Each added test MUST appear in tests_added with one sentence naming the contract it proves. That existing disclosure contract remains unchanged.
Automated checks MUST NOT judge a test's contract value.

The duration ceiling on the fast lane's qualified rolling daily average MUST be a release advisory and MUST NOT fail or route a stage on suite-cost grounds. A breach MUST record a run advisory and queue a performance intake for `/pan-tune-harness`. The harness MAY run mechanical structural checks on test placement and fixture construction.
A count budget MUST NOT decide a tune verdict.
The preceding permission is bounded to the operator directive of 2026-09-14 in tune session `tune-1789426062833` and MUST NOT be generalized beyond that directive.
Duration MAY support a MERGE or DEMOTE verdict only after signal and contract analysis support that verdict.
A review finding about test value, cost, fixtures, or lane placement MUST cite a stable TP identifier from the handbook and concrete test evidence.

guidance_sources.read_trigger: Read this guidance before you write, review, or test self-development tests.
